## Task 15

```{python}
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
SELECT
  country_region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'High income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_income,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Upper middle income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upper_middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Lower middle income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_middle,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Low income' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_income,
  SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category IS NULL OR country_income_category = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM wdi_country
GROUP BY country_region;
""")
```

## Task 18

```{python}
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
WITH regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_region FROM wdi_country
),
incomes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_income_category FROM wdi_country
),
all_combos AS (
  SELECT r.country_region, i.country_income_category
  FROM regions r CROSS JOIN incomes i
),
existing AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_region, country_income_category
  FROM wdi_country
)
SELECT a.*
FROM all_combos a
LEFT JOIN existing e
ON a.country_region = e.country_region AND a.country_income_category IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.country_income_category
WHERE e.country_region IS NULL;
""")
```

## Task 19

```{python}
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT country_region, country_income_category, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM wdi_country
  GROUP BY country_region, country_income_category
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT country_region, SUM(count) AS total_by_region
  FROM base
  GROUP BY country_region
),
income_totals AS (
  SELECT country_income_category, SUM(count) AS total_by_income
  FROM base
  GROUP BY country_income_category
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.country_region,
  b.country_income_category,
  b.count,
  r.total_by_region,
  i.total_by_income,
  g.total,
  ROUND((b.count * 100.0 / g.total), 2) AS percent_of_total
FROM base b
JOIN region_totals r ON b.country_region = r.country_region
JOIN income_totals i ON b.country_income_category IS NOT DISTINCT FROM i.country_income_category
JOIN grand_total g;
""")
```

## Task 20

```{python}
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT country_region, country_income_category, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM wdi_country
  GROUP BY country_region, country_income_category
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total FROM base
)
SELECT
  country_region,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'High income' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total, 2) AS high,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Upper middle income' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total, 2) AS upper_middle,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Lower middle income' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total, 2) AS lower_middle,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category = 'Low income' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total, 2) AS low,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN country_income_category IS NULL OR country_income_category = '' THEN count ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / total, 2) AS unknown
FROM base, total_sum
GROUP BY country_region, total;
""")
```

## Task 21

```{python}
run_sql_and_return_html(cnx,"""
WITH base AS (
  SELECT country_income_category, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM wdi_country
  GROUP BY country_income_category
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count FROM base
)
SELECT
  base.country_income_category,
  base.count,
  total.total_count,
  ROUND(base.count * 100.0 / total.total_count, 2) AS percent_of_total
FROM base, total;
""")
